name: ragaas
display_name: RAG as a Service — Sovereign RAG
description: Agent-callable tools over the RagaaS/RAG as a Service sovereign RAG pipeline: grounded-or-abstain answers with citations, hybrid retrieval, multi-turn conversation, cross-department federated query, and governance (attestation, usage, grants). Every tool inherits the platform's guardrails, tenancy, faithfulness checks, and tamper-evident audit trail.

tenant.title: Organisation / tenant id
tenant.description: The tenant this stdio server instance acts for. The server is bound to exactly this tenant at launch and never accepts a client-supplied tenant.

token.title: Platform JWT or service-account API key
token.description: Validated against the tenant above. Mint a dev token with scripts/mcp-connect.sh, or use a service-account key (ek_…) in production.

tools.name: rag.list_kbs
tools.description: List the knowledge bases the caller's organisation owns.

tools.name: rag.list_documents
tools.description: List the documents in a knowledge base (id, type, tags).

tools.name: rag.retrieve
tools.description: Hybrid retrieval → ranked cited spans (no generation).

tools.name: rag.query
tools.description: Grounded-or-abstain answer with citations for a question.

tools.name: rag.conversation
tools.description: Multi-turn ask that keeps context via a conversation_id.

tools.name: rag.ingest
tools.description: Ingest a plain-text document (requires the ingestor role).

tools.name: rag.federated_query
tools.description: Federated RAG cross-department answer over own KBs + grant-authorised peers.

tools.name: rag.attestation
tools.description: Sovereignty & data-protection attestation report for a knowledge base.

tools.name: rag.usage
tools.description: Usage metering + indicative showback over a time window.

tools.name: rag.list_grants
tools.description: List Federated RAG federation grants issued/received (needs federation).

compatibility.note: stdio mode co-locates with the platform (it drives the pipeline in-process, so it needs the platform's stores/models reachable). For a remote deployment, connect over HTTP to /mcp instead — see plugin/README.md.
